trace: canonical 61 public fields plus integer time_ps on every 40 MHz observation row
identity_rules: TX identity comes only from explicit TX-adoption sidecar
startup zero has no request ID
HOLD inherits the prior adopted ID, PCM24 and clip exactly

clock_serial_rules.format: PT8211 LSBJ; WS low right, WS high left

deadline_rules.tx_consumption: only at independent FRAME; 833/834 cadence is separate

termination_rules: tail without authoritative finish is PENDING
finish with open, returned or committed-unadopted transaction is REJECT
finish with partial serial word is REJECT
forbidden_inferences: WAV sample rate as FPGA LRCLK
